description: Tool definitions in the OpenAI function-calling format. The mesh translates them for Anthropic models. Every schema an agent carries is re-sent as input tokens on EVERY model call that agent makes, which is one reason Part 3's specialists carry two or three tools instead of six.

function.name: search_kb
function.description: Search Northstar's policy knowledge base. Returns the most relevant policy passages. Use it for any question about what the policy says; do not answer policy questions from memory.

query.description: A focused search query, for example 'restocking fee opened item'.

function.name: get_order
function.description: Look up one order: items and prices, shipping paid, delivery date, item condition, and whether the buyer is a Northstar Pro subscriber.

function.name: get_account
function.description: Look up one customer account: plan, monthly subscription fee, account status, and the latest invoice with its payment status.

function.name: get_uptime
function.description: Measured monthly uptime for an account's production API and storefront, with planned maintenance already excluded.

month.description: Calendar month as YYYY-MM, for example 2026-10.

function.name: get_api_usage
function.description: API usage for an account's production key over the last 7 days: peak requests per minute and the number of 429 responses.

function.name: get_login_status
function.description: Login state for one user: recent failed password attempts, whether the account is locked, login method, role, and two-factor status.
